label: rewarded D1 late in the episode, ahead of an a2 choice
explanation: Fires only at D1, and only when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded): (phase==D1)&(in_rew==1) has recall 1.0 and mass recall 1.0 but precision 0.24. It never fires at GO or D2, on unrewarded D1s, or on D1 steps with a fixation error. Two things gate it within rewarded D1s. (1) Episode position: it is silent for trials 0-9, nearly silent before trial 40, and its rate rises steadily to 14% at trials 90-99. (2) The agent upcoming choice: rate 7.6% before a2 vs 2.2% before a1, which goes with good==S2 and with a moderately negative choice logit (-4.4 to -1.5). It also needs low-to-mid model value (none above value 7.7). The upcoming action is the agent own computed choice, so it is legitimate; prev_action==2 does worse (F1 0.54). Magnitude grows over consecutive rewarded D1s (e.g. 0.24, 0.34, 0.36, 0.37) and resets after an unrewarded trial, so it looks like a reward-streak integrator, but predicates requiring two rewards in a row did not beat the recorded one (F1 0.58-0.64). Adding value<7.5 raises dev F1 only from 0.676 to 0.686, so the simpler predicate is recorded. Dev: P 0.62, R 0.74, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.74.
